selected_research_objective.question: Does exact typed restart-source authentication remain vulnerable to accepting an internally valid but stale rollback/freeze state when no independent freshness witness is present?
selected_research_objective.hypothesis: WP901 G3 authenticates internal typed lineage but does not yet compare the candidate restart generation/checkpoint against a separately trusted latest-seen freshness anchor; therefore a coherent rollback of the entire local evidence set can remain internally valid at G3 component scope.
selected_research_objective.counterhypothesis: The existing direct-successor generation constraint and exact causal/source digest binding are sufficient to make rollback impossible without producing a mismatch, so a separate freshness witness would add complexity without closing a real gap.
selected_research_objective.cheapest_discriminator: Compare WP901 G3 source/tests with mature rollback/freeze defenses that distinguish authenticity from previously trusted version/freshness state; defer F2 experiment until source-level mapping establishes a concrete falsifier.
